basic_details.scholarship_name: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University (PNU) International Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University & Ministry of Education (Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia - largest women's university in the world)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Exclusively for female students across: College of Computer and Information Sciences (CS, AI, Cybersecurity, Data Science), College of Engineering (Industrial, Electrical, Biomedical), College of Science (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematical Sciences, Biology), College of Business Administration, College of Health and Rehabilitation Sciences, College of Arts and Design, College of Languages (English, Translation).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~300 to 450 fully funded international scholarships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition for female applicants from Islamic and partner countries; Pakistan has regular representation (typically 15 to 30 female scholars awarded/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full normative degree duration: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's (including preparatory year); 2 years for Master's

nationality_requirements: Non-Saudi female citizens holding a valid passport from an eligible country
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years of age; Master's applicants must be 30 years or younger.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed higher secondary education (FSc or A-Levels) with high academic distinction (minimum 85%+ marks) for Bachelor's; Bachelor's degree (16 years) with minimum 3.00 CGPA for Master's.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: High school average of at least 85% (very good / ممتاز); competitive applicants present 90%+ marks.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Scientific stream (Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology) required for engineering, computing, health, and science colleges.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated from secondary school or completing final semester.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: High school graduation certificate must not have been issued more than 5 years prior to application.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not required; academic excellence and character references prioritized.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic min 5.5 or TOEFL min 65 for English-taught STEM/business programs; Arabic language preparatory course available for non-Arabic speakers.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English or Arabic depending on program track; Arabic Institute provides full-time preparatory language year.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female only (Princess Nourah University is an all-women institution).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have previously been awarded another scholarship by an institution in Saudi Arabia.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided for all preparatory and academic degree semesters.

admission_application_fee.details: Application through official PNU international admissions portal is 100% free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free fully furnished, secure, climate-controlled on-campus residential housing in PNU Student Residence Village.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend: SAR 840/month for undergraduate students (~PKR 62,000/month); SAR 900 to 1,000/month for Master's students (~PKR 66,000 to 74,000/month).
monthly_stipend.amount: SAR 840 to SAR 1,000 / month (~PKR 62,000 to 74,000 / month)

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy airfare ticket provided between Riyadh and Pakistan.

visa_fee.details: Saudi student entry visa, residence permit (Iqama), and medical checkup covered and sponsored by PNU.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive medical and dental healthcare provided at King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz University Hospital (KAAUH) on PNU campus.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus cafeterias and food court meals across the campus (~SAR 5 to 10 per meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free course textbooks provided; preparation allowance of SAR 1,800 paid upon initial arrival for books/clothing.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Graduation thesis allowance (SAR 3,000) paid upon completing degree.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Automated automated driverless metro system operating inside PNU campus (11.5 km track, 14 stations) is 100% free.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #1 globally for largest women's university campus (8 million sq meters); Top 700 QS World University Rankings; Top 10 in Saudi Arabia.
available_majors: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Business Administration, Accounting, Health & Rehabilitation Sciences, Graphic Design, Interior Architecture
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 48 to 60 months (4-5 years for Bachelor's) or 24 months (Master's)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: High school certificate (85%+ marks) or Bachelor's degree (3.00+ CGPA) for female applicants with medical fitness and police clearance.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Science, AI, and Biomedical Engineering are the most selective programs; business and languages have slightly higher acceptance ratios.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply via the unified 'Study in Saudi' portal or PNU direct international scholarship portal during the open window.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: PNU International Scholarships Portal / Study in Saudi Platform
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an applicant profile on the PNU International Admissions portal or Study in Saudi national platform.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check open application window on PNU website (typically open during spring for autumn intake).
2. Create account on PNU international admissions portal.
3. Select target degree level and desired college.
4. Upload academic transcripts, secondary school certificate, passport copy, and personal photo.
5. Upload medical fitness certificate and certificate of good conduct (police clearance).
6. Submit online application (100% free of charge).
7. PNU scholarship committee screens applications and forwards nominations to Saudi Ministry of Education.
8. Ministry of Education and security clearance approval (June-July).
9. Selected candidates receive visa authorization and electronic airfare ticket.
10. Arrival in Riyadh in late August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application for admission and external scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by applicant or provided by school principal/community leaders.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal motivation letter detailing academic objectives and reasons for seeking education at PNU.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Required for Master's applicants: 1-2 page outline of proposed research topic.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing education, certifications, and language proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally document-based evaluation; select graduate departments may conduct online verification interviews.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None; language test required for English-track STEM programs.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation of educational credentials by IBCC/HEC, MOFA Pakistan, and Saudi Cultural Mission / Embassy in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Arabic or English translations required.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online through PNU portal or Study in Saudi platform.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid international passport with at least 18 months validity
Official transcripts and diploma with minimum 85% average
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC / HEC, MOFA, and Saudi Cultural Mission

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official medical certificate proving freedom from contagious diseases
Certificate of good conduct issued by police authorities
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Police Character Certificate issued by Pakistani police

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letters of recommendation from teachers or community leaders
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From high school principal and science teacher

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake; enrollment commences in late August for the autumn academic semester.

selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: Language proficiency evaluated for direct English track
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Deanship of Admission and Registration at PNU and Ministry of Education Scholarship Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document screening and grade ranking -> Ministry of Education clearance -> University issuance of scholarship and visa award.

competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 90.0%+ in high school (or 3.60+ / 4.00 CGPA for graduate)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High-achieving female students with strong academic discipline, top marks in mathematics and sciences, and exemplary conduct records.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani female scholars from Punjab, Sindh, KPK, and federal colleges pursuing computing, biomedical sciences, and business.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Egypt, Jordan, Indonesia, Malaysia, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Yemen.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized agency portals claiming guaranteed PNU admission: pnu-scholarships-direct.org, saudi-women-grants.com.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: PNU application is 100% free of charge. Never pay any external agent or website.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: PNU does not employ any commercial intermediaries; selections are conducted directly by university deanships.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Saudi Embassy document attestation fees (~PKR 30,000 to 45,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: A male guardian (Mahram) is required to reside with the student. (Truth: The Saudi Ministry of Education no longer requires female international scholarship students to be accompanied by a Mahram; students live safely in protected on-campus dormitories).
MYTH: Engineering is not taught at PNU. (Truth: PNU has a dedicated College of Engineering with modern robotics, biomedical, and electrical laboratories).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial sites claim students must pay dorm fees; PNU international scholarship recipients receive 100% free on-campus housing.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 out of 5.00 throughout the academic course.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence at PNU campus; adherence to university residential rules and code of conduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual academic GPA review at the conclusion of the second semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Outside employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; female graduates are eligible to seek employment in Saudi Arabia under local work visa sponsorship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if student drops out, fails GPA threshold for two consecutive semesters, or violates disciplinary rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing colleges requires approval from the Deanship of Admission and Registration.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum duration is 5 years for Bachelor's and 2 years for Master's; extensions rarely granted.
